title: The impact of work–family equilibrium on employee proactive behaviors
core_idea: Investigate how different equilibrium states between work–family conflict and work–family facilitation influence employees' proactive behaviors, and whether emotional exhaustion and psychological capital mediate this relationship, using polynomial regression and response surface analysis grounded in resource conservation theory (data collected from companies, employees, and HR managers).
tldr: Examines how the balance between work–family conflict and facilitation relates to employee proactive behavior and the mediating roles of emotional exhaustion and psychological capital, using polynomial regression and response surface analysis.
